_doc: Leads: gossip that points at something real that isn't a quest (CLAUDE.md, Rumours that lead somewhere). A people.json topic with `lead: <id>` puts one in the Journal under Rumours (js/quests.js `lead`). Each: title, where (said in the Journal), text (the way to it, plainly), kind (boss, place, shop, buyer, maker, crew, secret, event, fight, climb, fishing, board, festival, person), world + label (the thing it points at: the Journal's Map button, and using it follows the lead; no label: arriving there does; no world: that label anywhere), and optionally festival (an id in festivals.json), board ('farm' or a planet in js/boards.js), when ('bloom' or 'festival': a line of when it's next, worked out as it's shown), unless ('holm', 'crew:<id>', 'quest:<id>': not worth telling once that's true). tools/tests/world/rumours.js checks every one against the game.

dredge.title: The Dredge
dredge.text: Once a day a dredger the size of a room hauls itself out of the black water in the Sump, under the Undercity. Beat it for sump pearls and chrome.

crown-room.title: The Crown Room
crown-room.label: THE CROWN ROOM
crown-room.text: The Duchess keeps her own table up past the velvet rope. Win 1,000 at the Card Room's poker tables and Bruno lets you up.

gold-chips.title: Gold chips
gold-chips.label: THE BOUTIQUE
gold-chips.text: The Royale's boutique sells real gold chips, too good to bet. Mama Keiko on Lantern Row and Inspector Halloran at the spaceport would treasure one.

mori-kitchen.title: Chef Mori's kitchen
mori-kitchen.where: Arcadia · Aurum, off the Royale's floor
mori-kitchen.label: CHEF MORI
mori-kitchen.text: Chef Mori at Aurum pays more than anyone for food grown under a real sun: starfruit above all, then pumpkins, honey and strawberries from Verdance.

desh-crew.title: Crew wanted on the Old Mercy
desh-crew.label: CAPTAIN DESH
desh-crew.text: Captain Desh is signing on at the spaceport. With her on your books, every ship you own carries a tenth more.

lumen.title: LUMEN
lumen.label: THE COLLECTION
lumen.text: Iris Kade's boutique up in the Spires fits designer chrome: the finest implants in the city, starlight optics among them.

undercroft-bell.title: A drowned bell
undercroft-bell.label: THE UNDERCROFT
undercroft-bell.text: The Undercroft under Midnight Isle opens every night, a new crypt each time. Among the relics in its chests there's a drowned bell.

morwen-cold.title: Cold things for the sorceress
morwen-cold.label: SORCERESS
morwen-cold.text: Morwen, in her tower on Midnight Isle, buys bat wings and wraith essence from Hoarfell's hidden valley. Mirelle in Sylvara does too.

starling-holm.title: Starling Holm
starling-holm.label: FOR SALE
starling-holm.text: A small island in the Emerald Sea with a cottage on it and a FOR SALE sign. Whoever buys it can build: a workshop, a slipway, a hall.

saltmere-lockets.title: Drowned lockets
saltmere-lockets.label: THE DROWNED STREET
saltmere-lockets.text: The drowned in Saltmere's sunken street carry lockets, and so does the ghost ship on the Midnight Sea. Vesper Quick, the fence on Cinder Key, buys every one.

sovereign.title: The Sovereign II
sovereign.label: THE ARSENAL
sovereign.text: The Arsenal's clerk keeps a ledger of what the galleon on the stocks still wants: rope, oak planks, iron bars, pitch, sailcloth. Put in your share and she launches on regatta day.

bounties.title: Cinder Key's bounties
bounties.label: WANTED
bounties.text: Three wanted ships a week on the board in Cinder Key's square. Sink one at sea and Scarlet Dee pays the bounty, with something from the captain's cabin.

dragon-riddle.title: The dragon's riddle
dragon-riddle.label: DRAGON
dragon-riddle.text: Down the cave on Crimson Reach, the dragon asks a riddle once a Lumar day. The answer's always somewhere on Lumar's islands. Guess it for a coin from her hoard.

bridge-booths.title: The Old Bridge's booths
bridge-booths.label: TACKLE BOOTH
bridge-booths.text: The tackle booth on the Old Bridge sells a silk line that brings the rare fish up more for a day. The flower booth has posies, the sweet booth toffee ships.

stormwatch.title: Old Wick's barometer
stormwatch.label: BAROMETER BOARD
stormwatch.text: Up in the Stormwatch on Cinder Key, Old Wick's barometer board reads what every sea will do for the next few hours.

lanternfall-bell.title: The bells of Lanternfall
lanternfall-bell.label: BELL
lanternfall-bell.text: Lanternfall rings its church bells for every boat that comes in through the caldera's mouth. Pull the rope yourself, once a day.

nerys-caldera.title: Caldera fish
nerys-caldera.label: NERYS
nerys-caldera.text: What you catch off Lanternfall's jetty fetches its best price from Nerys on Sapphire Port's floating market: sapphire rays, glass swordfish, even a crownfin.

glassworks-pipe.title: The glassblower's pipe
glassworks-pipe.label: THE PIPE
glassworks-pipe.text: Ione at the Sapphire Glassworks lets anyone try the pipe, and the first go each day is free. A float that comes out round can go on the shelf in your quarters.

rosewell-bath.title: The hot baths
rosewell-bath.label: THE BATH
rosewell-bath.text: Rosewell's bathhouse fills from springs that come up hot through the crystals. A bath puts your health and energy back and keeps the cold off for hours.

lanternfall-islet.title: The islet after dark
lanternfall-islet.label: THE VIEW
lanternfall-islet.text: Look out from Lanternfall's parapet after dark: the islet glows red in the black bay, and the zigzag's lamps run down the cliff to the water.

rose-songstone.title: Songstone
rose-songstone.label: THE LIFT
rose-songstone.text: Songstone comes out of the Rose Mine's deepest floors. Hob at the mine buys it, and Kassia on the floating market pays a little more.

caldera-lantern.title: Lanterns that never blow out
caldera-lantern.label: LANTERN MAKER
caldera-lantern.text: The lantern maker on Lanternfall's zigzag sells caldera lanterns that burn in any wind. Carry one after dark and fish come up to its light.

bath-tile.title: The tile that's different
bath-tile.label: TILES
bath-tile.text: A hundred blue tiles in Rosewell's bathhouse, all the same, says Oda. The girl who made them says one isn't. Look low.

sea-clock.title: A clock that keeps Lumar's hours
sea-clock.label: INSTRUMENT MAKER
sea-clock.text: Oswin Brassworth in the Canal Quarter makes chronometers that keep Lumar's eight-hour day, and a wrist one too.

spore-bloom.title: The spore bloom
spore-bloom.label: TELESCOPE
spore-bloom.text: A night or two a month the whole spore sea lights up, each sea its own colour, and the fish bite better. Dr Vesper on Crownhaven's Hill turns her telescope down for it.

catch-auction.title: The catch auction
catch-auction.label: FISH MARKET
catch-auction.text: When the boats come in, the catch goes under the hammer by Crownhaven's fish market (and on Diggen's Point, Tern Holm, Sapphire Port, Rose Cove and Crimson Reach). Bid for it.

silk-trees.title: Silk cocoons
silk-trees.label: SILK TREES
silk-trees.text: The silk moths' trees in Rosewell give up cocoons every day. Bring Seren five and she weaves a spore silk scarf: a gift anyone loves.

summit-register.title: The summit register
summit-register.label: SUMMIT REGISTER
summit-register.text: Climb the Hoarspire from Fellhaven (the route board's at the foot of the face) and sign the register at the top. Hoar crystals glint in the rock off the line.

ice-hole.title: Char under the ice
ice-hole.label: ICE HOLE
ice-hole.text: There's a hole cut in the pond ice in Fellhaven. Arctic char come up through it, frostfin now and then, and Tove at the cocoa hut buys both.

high-route.title: Skiing the bowl
high-route.label: BUREAU DES GUIDES
high-route.text: The guides' bureau in Aurelle takes you over the High Route: the glacier, the Col du Vent, and a bowl with no poles in it, down to Bram's refuge.

juno-park.title: Juno's score
juno-park.label: SCOREBOARD
juno-park.text: Juno's name is at the top of the Park's scoreboard: 7,500, every rail in one combo. Beat it and she pays.

harvest-fair.title: The Harvest Fair
harvest-fair.text: The last weekend of Verdance's autumn, Brambleford puts on its Harvest Fair: Old Ludd judges the produce, and the best pumpkin takes the rosette.

ysolde-crew.title: Ysolde would sign on
ysolde-crew.label: YSOLDE
ysolde-crew.text: You've been out on the Last Ridge, further than Ysolde got. Ask her at the guide's hut whether she'd join your crew: she'd kit you against the cold and probe the snow ahead of you.

wat-shoes.title: New shoes
wat-shoes.label: WAT
wat-shoes.text: Wat the farrier at the Anvil & Hoof shoes your horse for 20 coins: she goes a little quicker under you for a Verdance day.

ludd-mill.title: Old Ludd's mill
ludd-mill.label: OLD LUDD
ludd-mill.text: Old Ludd grinds your wheat at Brambleford's watermill for nothing, three sheaves a sack, and buys that flour back for the fair's bread.

lost-goat.title: A goat that answers to nothing
lost-goat.label: THE FARM STAND
lost-goat.text: Somebody's goat is loose. Walkers see it in the sunken lane on the Downs of an evening, by the honesty box, eating the notes. Go at dusk.

village-wants.title: The fund's little wants
village-wants.label: THE VILLAGE FUND
village-wants.text: With the five projects done, Brambleford's fund board asks for one small thing a week: coins and something from your farm. Every Friday the county judges Best Kept Village and reads what's been done.

farm-orders.title: The farm's order board
farm-orders.label: NOTICE BOARD
farm-orders.text: The board by the farm on Verdance posts orders every day from people across the worlds (Tove wants pumpkins for the lift crew). They pay well over a sale.

silverrun-fishing.title: A line in the Silverrun
silverrun-fishing.label: OFF THE CANOE DOCK
silverrun-fishing.text: Tamsin at the canoe dock says trout and silverscale take a line off the dock or below the otter weir, and after dark a moon carp comes up to look at the moon, most of all at the full. She buys what you catch.

enigma-dispatches.title: The station's old traffic
enigma-dispatches.label: CIPHER TERMINAL
enigma-dispatches.text: Okafor says every code you crack at the cipher terminal on Enigma's relay deck decodes one of the station's old dispatches: shift swaps, supply orders, notices. They go in your journal's log.

warden-cloak.title: A warden's cloak
warden-cloak.label: WEAVER
warden-cloak.text: Aerin says Ysane at the Rootmarket's looms weaves the wardens' cloaks: four silk cocoons from Rosewell's groves and three owlmoss for the dye. In one, creatures notice you later.

peddler.title: Wendel the Peddler
peddler.label: PEDDLER
peddler.text: Wendel Crane sets up somewhere different every day: the Market Square, Arcadia's street, Brambleford's square, Fellhaven, Sapphire Port's quay, Enigma's dock. He sells things that do things.
